typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Proc_Code as string,
		UOfM as string,
		Name as string,
		End_Date as string,
		NDC as string,
		Eff_Date as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource1
FlatFileSource1 sink(input(
		Proc_Code as string,
		UOfMeas as string,
		NDCDESCRIPTION as string,
		End_Date as string,
		NDC_CODE as string,
		Eff_Date as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		Proc_Code,
		UOfMeas = UOfM,
		NDCDESCRIPTION = Name,
		End_Date,
		NDC_CODE = NDC,
		Eff_Date)) ~> OLEDBDestination1
